note:
R120 (Players 3.1; review research-20260926-r113-r118 queue) - cross-title identity audit of weight, height, handedness, position and
nationality / birthplace on every distinct source of the R113 list (27 anchors -> 11 distinct gen6/gen7 + PS4 anchors, real NHL 20,
NHL 19 patch 56, NHL 15 PS4 patch 00; byte-identical aliases recorded, never re-counted).

Per source (exhibition player bio table): field metadata (depth, rangelow, rangehigh); raw distributions; decoded weight / height by the
stable encoding contract (weight = raw + 150 on NHL 07-10, raw + 120 afterwards, raw 0 = no weight; height = raw + 54 inches) - the audit
checks continuity, it does not re-derive the contract from populations.
Title-owned label evidence for nationality codes (no frequency guessing):
  (a) national-team rosters: the league whose clubs carry >= 4 of the abbreviations CAN USA SWE FIN RUS CZE SVK SUI GER; per national team,
      the `intlcountry` codes of its roster players (exhibitionrostertable.team -> exhibitionteams.index; .playerindex ->
      exhibitionplayers.index -> .playerid -> bio.game_id, the join Studio's RosterModel uses: eGlu.XSWT -> ZBac.vfEq -> ZBac.ykFq -> ubPc.wBIz);
  (b) stockintltourneyplayerstats.country versus the same player's `intlcountry`, playerid joined both directly to game_id and through
      exhibitionplayers.index (both reported).
Pairs: same-season cross-platform (X360 NHL 15 / PS4 NHL 15; Legacy / PS4 NHL 16), same-title variants (PS4 15 base / patch 00; NHL 19
base / patch 56) and adjacent seasons (X360 07 -> ... -> Legacy; PS4 15 -> 16 -> 17 -> 18 -> 19 base -> real 20 -> 21). Matching key K1 =
(first name, last name, calendar birth year / month / day) - birth date is not under investigation here; birth-year base 1959 when the
year field is narrower than 8 bits (NHL 07 / 08), else 1900; month / day base per R116. K1 keys occurring twice in a title are dropped
(counted as collisions). Second key K2 = `game_id`: agreement of K1 and K2 is reported as confidence, never used to add matches.
Read-only. Usage: python r120_identity_audit.py <out.json>
